name: Pixel 3

Network.Technology: GSM/EDGE, UMTS/HSPA+, CDMA EVDO Rev A, WCDMA, LTE, LTE Advanced

Body.Dimensions: Pixel 3:, H: 145.6 mm, W: 68.2 mm, D: 7.9 mm, Pixel 3 XL:, H: 158.0 mm, W: 76.7 mm, D: 7.9 mm
Body.Other: 18 W fast charging, Qi (standard), Qi wireless charging, Pixel Visual Core, Titan M security module

Display.Display: Pixel 3: 5.5 in FHD+ OLED at 443 ppi, pixel resolution (2:1) , Pixel 3 XL: 6.3 in QHD+ OLED at 523 ppi, (37:18) pixel resolution, Both displays have Corning Gorilla Glass 5 and 424 cd/m max brightness

Cameras.Rear camera: Sony Exmor IMX363 12.2 MP (1.4 μm) with 1.8 lens, Dual Pixel Phase autofocus, optical and electronic image stabilization, spectral + flicker sensor, 1080p at 30/60/120 fps, 720p at 30/60/240 fps, 4K at 30 fps
Cameras.Front camera: Sony Exmor IMX355 8 MP with 1.8 lens and 75° lens, second front camera with 8 MP, 2.2, fixed focus and 97° wide-angle lens, 1080p at 30 fps, 720p at 30 fps, 480p at 30 fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5.0 GHz 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 5.0 + LE, NFC, GPS (GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou), eSIM capable
